items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: He come down here, uh, played, uh, with Paul Moretz. He was playing with the Rhythm Kings then.

ctx.x: Oh, we can ask Raymond. Uh, what about rap? Did you hear him?

Yeah, I heard him rap play a few times. He was a wonderful clarinet man. He come down here, uh, played, uh, with Paul Moretz. He was playing with the Rhythm Kings then. And, uh, I heard him at the Italian Hall a couple of times in the French Union Hall. With, uh, they played benefits down there. With Paul Moretz was a trumpet man. Rap was clarinet. I think they had one of the Brunners on trombone, if I remember right. Either Merritt or...
I can't remember who they had on trombone.
